blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — Fire incidents in Baguio City declined by 27 percent in the first 10 months of 2026, with 43 cases recorded from January to October, compared with 59 during the same period last year. According to Senior Fire Officer 1 Ashley Lloyd Furigay, head of the Baguio City Fire Station (BCFS) Public Information Unit, structural fires accounted for 35 of this year’s incidents, down from 45 during the same period in 2025.
